notes.title: January major update! Jumps, shortcuts, optional retro mode and new physics!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45070407/b659fbf4d6e1d1961c51ff7312cb5bd52d4e038a.png[/img]

January major content update! Game build have been enhanced with shortcuts jumping ramps, optional retro rendering mode ( work-in-progress ) new, updated physics, and many other changes, that came into  the game! Our community voted, that they want to see shortcuts in the game to make up for lost seconds. To use the shortcut, the player will have to hit the ramp while driving above the required speed and be careful not to fall off the track, or touch the explosive barrels, as this will result in instant death. We want to give you a demo version for testing soon, so stay tuned!
